title: Shoulder
simplified_paragraphs: 我很小的时候认为身体最重要的部位是眼睛，因为眼睛可以看见蓝天、看见白云、看见我们爱的人。奶奶说：这个世界上有很多盲人啊。
后来我开始学习音乐，我认为身体最重要的部位是耳朵或者嘴，因为耳朵可以听到世界上最美的声音，嘴可以唱出好听的歌。爷爷说：但这个世界也有很多聋哑人。
几年以后，我好朋友的爸爸去世了，她非常伤心，我陪着她度过了那段不开心的日子。回家以后，妈妈对我说：现在，你知道最重要的部位是哪了吗？没错，是肩膀。因为在我们爱的人哭泣的时候，肩膀可以让他们依靠。我们每个人都需要肩膀，我们自己也要有强壮肩膀留给别人。
traditional_paragraphs: 我很小的時候認為身體最重要的部位是眼睛，因為眼睛可以看見藍天、看見白雲、看見我們愛的人。奶奶說：這個世界上有很多盲人啊。
後來我開始學習音樂，我認為身體最重要的部位是耳朵或者嘴，因為耳朵可以聽到世界上最美的聲音，嘴可以唱出好聽的歌。爺爺說：但這個世界也有很多聾啞人。
幾年以後，我好朋友的爸爸去世了，她非常傷心，我陪著她度過了那段不開心的日子。回家以後，媽媽對我說：現在，你知道最重要的部位是哪了嗎？沒錯，是肩膀。因為在我們愛的人哭泣的時候，肩膀可以讓他們依靠。我們每個人都需要肩膀，我們自己也要有強壯肩膀留給別人。

hòu lái wǒ kāi shǐ xué xí yīn yuè， wǒ rèn wéi shēn tǐ zuì zhòng yào de bù wèi shì ěr duo huò zhě zuǐ， yīn wèi ěr duo kě yǐ tīng dào shì jiè shàng zuì měi de shēng yīn， zuǐ kě yǐ chàng chū hǎo tīng de gē。 yé ye shuō： dàn zhè gè shì jiè yě yǒu hěn duō lóng yǎ rén。

jǐ nián yǐ hòu， wǒ hǎo péng you de bà ba qù shì le， tā fēi cháng shāng xīn， wǒ péi zhe tā dù guò le nà duàn bù kāi xīn de rì zi。 huí jiā yǐ hòu， mā ma duì wǒ shuō： xiàn zài， nǐ zhī dào zuì zhòng yào de bù wèi shì nǎ le ma？ méi cuò， shì jiān bǎng。 yīn wèi zài wǒ men ài de rén kū qì de shí hou， jiān bǎng kě yǐ ràng tā men yī kào。 wǒ men měi gè rén dōu xū yào jiān bǎng， wǒ men zì jǐ yě yào yǒu qiáng zhuàng jiān bǎng liú gěi bié rén。
english_paragraphs: When I was very young, I thought that the most important part of the body was the eyes, because the eyes can see the blue sky, white clouds, and the people we love. Grandma said: There are many blind people in the world.

Later I started studying music. I think the most important part of the body is the ears or the mouth, because the ears can hear the most beautiful sounds in the world, and the mouth can sing beautiful songs. Grandpa said: But there are also many deaf-mute people in this world.

A few years later, my good friend's father passed away. She was very sad. I stayed with her through those unhappy days. After returning home, my mother said to me: Now, do you know where the most important part is? Yes, it's the shoulder. Because a shoulder is there for our loved ones to cry on when they cry. Each of us needs shoulders, and we must also have strong shoulders for others.
english_full:
When I was very young, I thought that the most important part of the body was the eyes, because the eyes can see the blue sky, white clouds, and the people we love. Grandma said: There are many blind people in the world.

Later I started studying music. I think the most important part of the body is the ears or the mouth, because the ears can hear the most beautiful sounds in the world, and the mouth can sing beautiful songs. Grandpa said: But there are also many deaf-mute people in this world.

A few years later, my good friend's father passed away. She was very sad. I stayed with her through those unhappy days. After returning home, my mother said to me: Now, do you know where the most important part is? Yes, it's the shoulder. Because a shoulder is there for our loved ones to cry on when they cry. Each of us needs shoulders, and we must also have strong shoulders for others.
